scripts.dev: npm run dev:runtime & npm run dev:portal
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:portal
scripts.lint: oxlint contracts shared runtime management scripts eval tests --ignore-pattern 'management/portal/**'
scripts.validate:deploy: helm lint runtime/deploy/helm && helm template sre-agent-manager runtime/deploy/helm -f runtime/deploy/helm/values/manager.yaml > /dev/null && helm template sre-agent-active-directory runtime/deploy/helm -f runtime/deploy/helm/values/active-directory.yaml > /dev/null && helm template sre-agent-openshift runtime/deploy/helm -f runtime/deploy/helm/values/openshift.yaml > /dev/null && helm template sre-agent-network-observability runtime/deploy/helm -f runtime/deploy/helm/values/network-observability.yaml > /dev/null && helm template sre-agent-keycloak runtime/deploy/helm -f runtime/deploy/helm/values/keycloak.yaml > /dev/null && helm template sre-agent-observability runtime/deploy/helm -f runtime/deploy/helm/values/observability.yaml > /dev/null && helm lint management/deploy/portal && helm template sre-agent-portal management/deploy/portal > /dev/null
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run validate:boundaries && npm run test && npm run validate:yaml && npm run validate:deploy
